summary: Narrow university service road between buildings, no room to stop clear of the lane.

drivers.seclusion: Walled in by university buildings 4-10 m from the kerb, with foot traffic and services; no homes.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow campus road with the west side running kerb-to-building and bollards mapped at 2 m and 4 m; the only bays are the car park on the east side near the start, not on this kerb.
drivers.traffic: Campus service route with pedestrians and delivery vehicles.
drivers.convention: No cars parked along the west kerb; the few vehicles seen are in the car park bays or at the far end.

flags: Campus buildings 4-10 m away, constant foot traffic
sun_shade: Mostly shaded by tall buildings either side; open overhead only at the road line.
